findings.statement: Start date used: 2024-01-01. NL-SPA-2023-014 (state plan amendment, published 2023-11-20) is the highest-authority source and states the weight-management GLP-1 coverage 'is effective January 1, 2024' [NL-SPA-2023-014#p1]. It covers GLP-1 agonists for chronic weight management in adults with BMI >= 30, or BMI >= 27 with at least one weight-related comorbidity, and leaves type 2 diabetes coverage unchanged [NL-SPA-2023-014#p1].

Conflicting date disclosed: NL-MAN-2024-RX, a provider manual published 2024-02-01, says weight-management coverage begins February 1, 2024 [NL-MAN-2024-RX#p1]. It is lower authority than the approved SPA and was not used as the start date. Federal rules tie plan-amendment effective dates to the rules for new plans [42-CFR-430.20(b)], consistent with the SPA controlling here.

GLP-1 prescriptions per 1,000 member-months: pre-period (2023Q1-2023Q4) mean 11.8 vs post-period (2024Q1-2024Q4) mean 16.4, a +38.8% change, 95% CI [36.4, 41.0], verdict significant_and_material at a 5% materiality threshold.

Quarterly rates were stable at 11.68-12.10 through 2023, then stepped to 16.67 in 2024Q1 and stayed in a 16.00-16.67 band through 2025Q2 (all final quarters), indicating a level shift at the policy quarter rather than a pre-existing trend.

Data coverage: NL quarters 2023Q1-2025Q2 are final; 2025Q3 and 2025Q4 are provisional (claims lag) and were excluded from the analysis. 12 suppressed rows exist statewide, including 8 in the analysis window.
